cases.title: Cabinet approves metro expansion
cases.body: The cabinet approved two corridors. Officials said tenders follow the approval.

cases.title: Ethanol plants get fresh interest subsidy
cases.body: Distilleries get interest subsidy with fresh allocation. The financing covers twelve units.

cases.title: Tenders invited for metro corridor
cases.body: Bids were invited through open tender. Bidding closes next month for the corridor tender.

cases.title: Construction begins on elevated road
cases.body: Work begins on Monday with a foundation stone ceremony. Ground-breaking follows years of planning.

cases.title: Sixty percent work complete on corridor
cases.body: The elevated road is under construction with work in progress on all spans. Officials cite steady progress.

cases.title: Bridge opens for light traffic
cases.body: The bridge opened on Sunday after completion of load tests. The ready structure eases congestion.

cases.title: University inaugurates new school
cases.body: The vice-chancellor inaugurated the school at a ceremony. The inauguration drew faculty from five countries.

cases.title: Metro misses deadline, delayed by a year
cases.body: The project is behind schedule after missing its deadline. Work stalled for months on land disputes.

cases.title: Toll contract cancelled after violations
cases.body: The contract was cancelled and the operator blacklisted. The cancellation follows repeated violations.

cases.title: Survey pegs growth at 9.2 percent
cases.body: The economic survey report reveals steady growth. Findings show construction leading the findings charts.

cases.title: CAG flags expenditure irregularities
cases.body: The CAG audit flagged irregularities. Auditors cited excess payments in the audit report.

cases.title: High Court directs forensic audit
cases.body: The court directed officials to comply. The verdict follows a petition hearing last month.

cases.title: New DM takes charge in Patna
cases.body: The newly appointed officer takes charge on Monday. The appointment ends weeks of vacancy.

cases.title: Twelve officers transferred
cases.body: A transfer order moved officers across districts. The postings take effect immediately.

cases.title: BPSC opens applications for 27,000 posts
cases.body: Applications are invited online for the recruitment. Admit cards arrive before the hiring rounds.

cases.title: Cabinet approves new industrial policy
cases.body: The new policy amends investment rules. Revised guidelines create a single-window framework.

cases.title: Solar pump scheme launched for farmers
cases.body: The scheme launched on Sunday covers 10,000 farmers. The rollout begins with pilot blocks.

cases.title: Teachers protest transfer policy
cases.body: Teachers marched in protest through the town. The demonstration entered its second week of strike.

cases.title: Candidates file nominations
cases.body: Nomination papers flooded in as campaigning peaked. Roadshows marked the final day before polling.

cases.title: Bus overturns, twelve killed
cases.body: The bus overturned in a horrific crash. The injured were rushed to hospital after the accident.

cases.title: Three arrested after robbery
cases.body: Police arrested three men for robbery. An FIR was registered in the theft case.

cases.title: Wetland census finds new visitors
cases.body: The census report recorded new species. Findings will shape the official survey record.

cases.title: Midday meal menu revised
cases.body: The revised menu amends nutrition norms. New guidelines apply from next month.

cases.title: Relief camps house 40,000
cases.body: Camps house the displaced as waters recede. Kitchens serve meals twice daily. (No vocabulary event: documented gap.)

cases.title: Actor tours three cities
cases.body: The actor promotes the new movie across cities. Fans gathered along the route.

cases.title: State wins thriller by two runs
cases.body: Chasing 240, the team held its nerve. The captain praised the bowlers after the win.

cases.title: Opinion: why the city chokes
cases.body: In my view, enforcement fails each winter. This column argues for dust control.

cases.title: In pictures: festival week
cases.body: Glimpses from the ground in this pictures roundup.

cases.title: Government proposes riverside township
cases.body: The draft plan proposes a township with housing and parks. The proposal invites public objections.

cases.title: BPSC releases recruitment calendar
cases.body: The commission announced the examination calendar. The announcement covers 27,000 posts.

cases.title: पटना मेट्रो विस्तार को मंजूरी
cases.body: कैबिनेट ने दो कॉरिडोर को मंजूरी दी। स्वीकृति के बाद निविदाएं आएंगी।
